name: TeamStarWolf - Credential Theft & Abuse
description: Curated practitioner view of Credential Theft & Abuse behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Obtaining and reusing credentials: dumping, cracking, harvesting from stores and files, protocol attacks, and using stolen material to authenticate. Cross-tactic selection of Enterprise ATT&CK techniques; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting), not incident frequency. Every technique ID and tactic is validated against the workbench's bundled ATT&CK v19.2 data.
